packages.brief: Judge D1 and D2 without a compiler: parse the interface for implementation bodies and prove no caller names an implementation.
Extend D9 from declared nouns to stem-matched nouns, and prove it does not fire on a word both domains legitimately own.
Generate descriptor stubs for a whole ISIC section in one run, each with its ISCO and ISCED cross-references read from the FAKIR lattice file rather than passed by hand.
Add the ILM language axis to generation so a domain is seeded as (domain x AGI layer x language), matching FAKIR's three-axis seeding model.
Emit the correlation graph in the {nodes,families,layers} shape zistgah/dome's pointcloud builder already consumes, so the graph mounts as a dome display with no new render code.
Add one cycler per invariant class so a contributor can be handed D4 (conformance authoring) or D7 (roadmap authoring) as a prompt cycle rather than a paragraph.
